    PastImpact

    Recordings breathe slowly. Live, the songs hit faster.Watch more sessions ↗

    One beat. One line. Lift-off.

    The journey began with “Minnesota,” a track born from pure spontaneity. Caleb laid down a beat; Mike heard it and said, “Let’s get straight to the stu.” The lyrics arrived naturally. They recorded it that day.

    What started across distances became a shared language. Vintage synths, programmed rhythms, dreamy samples and heavy guitar now meet in songs built for late-night focus, deep work, and the physical release of a live room. Each track is a launch sequence: calculated, unexpected, and made to escape a single genre.
